Definition: properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free)
BiblicalUsage: 1) remainder, excess, rest, remnant, excellence; 1a) remainder, remnant; 1b) remainder, rest, other part; 1c) excess; 1d) abundantly (adv); 1e) abundance, affluence; 1f) superiority, excellency
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
